resources.string: %1$s: hold a button and press a second one, or press one alone (5 s)

%1$s is on %2$s. Press A, then the buttons: hold one (the modifier, such as Select) and press a second, or press one alone. Left and right turn it off or put the usual one back. Its buttons reach the game as nothing while the chord is held; each alone still reaches the game.
%1$s: %2$s, held half a second; the game still gets the buttons. Guide, Back and a swipe from the left edge open the menu too.
Hotkeys apply to every game of every console, or to this game alone when its controls are « This game only ».
Same buttons as: %1$s. Both would happen.
The game uses %1$s: with this hotkey set, pressing it does the hotkey instead. Add a modifier (hold Select first).
Every hotkey back to the usual chords: Select + R2 held fast-forwards, Select + R1 quick saves, Select + L1 quick loads, Select + Start held opens the game menu.
Hotkeys back to the usual ones
